name: Zensus 2022 net cold rent (4000W-0009)
publisher: Statistische Ämter des Bundes und der Länder (Germany)

measures.definition: Average net cold rent per m² (without heating and service charges) of every rented flat of 40-59 m² on census day, 15 May 2022, times 50 m².
Average net cold rent per m² (without heating and service charges) of every rented flat of 80-99 m² on census day, 15 May 2022, times 90 m².

rights.attribution: © Statistische Ämter des Bundes und der Länder, Deutschland, 2026. Zensus 2022, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0

vetted.notes: Official census, every tenancy; each table states the Datenlizenz Deutschland attribution licence. Asking rents for German cities come from commercial portals and are not open.

caveats: Sitting rents on 15 May 2022, net of heating and service charges: a new lease in Berlin, Hamburg or Munich costs far more, often twice as much per m².
The next census is years away; until then this is the latest official rent level for each city.
